nodes.label: Money rules v2 roundToStep
nodes.rationale: Float-safe roundToStep with epsilon fixes verified browser/server Snapp mismatch; SQL uses exact numeric math; invariant owe+h_share==net+shipping_fee asserted in code and tests.

nodes.label: Product model no cost no stock availability toggle
nodes.rationale: Remove cost/stock/private tables to eliminate secret numbers between partners; availability is a blocker not a warning and archive preserves old order product names.

nodes.label: Notification recipients events merge rule
nodes.rationale: Actor is not notified, other partner gets DM plus push; same-order events in one batch merge to one DM/push to avoid spam; lock-screen-safe push text contains no PII or amounts.

nodes.label: RLS membership security is_member
nodes.rationale: Public anon key requires membership check not just authenticated; every write via security-definer RPC keeps validation and history atomic; disable public sign-up.
